note: Host capture scope of the QA/QC Department (QCQA) library (QA-01, gap-ebcbfa4bf804): the whole library from its root, where QA/QC files the scanned assembly-order packets ('AOs', docs/reference/cases-and-artifacts.md 3.1) and its other quality documents. The folders are the library's own listing (every folder under the root, walked breadth first within max_depth and max_folders), never a list in this file or in code; a bound that is reached leaves the root incomplete with that reason. Served by the host (operating/host.py) as an incremental capture: the first cycle walks the root, later cycles follow the drive's change feed and read only new and changed files, a full walk repeats every full_walk_hours (the host's coverage census, kept across the weekly check's runs, has its own window, census_max_age_hours 720: a library of this size takes several runs a week apart), and a walk the host's sharepoint budget_seconds cuts resumes in the next cycle. Configuration, never a grant: the capture principal still needs the live-source audience for every folder and item. Read-only.
